headline.en: Gavi left Elche with a knee problem and missed Saturday's session
headline.es: Gavi se retiro en Elche con la rodilla y no entrenó el sabado

summary.en: Gavi left the Elche match with a knee problem. Flick said the first medical reading was less serious than it looked and that a scan would confirm it. Gavi still missed the Athletic match and Saturday's training session. Pedri started in midfield instead.
summary.es: Gavi se retiro en Elche. Flick dijo que la primera lectura era menos grave. Aun asi se perdio el Athletic y el sabado. Pedri salio en el medio.

body.en: Gavi's history makes every knee sentence louder than the first reading deserves. Flick's wording after Elche was careful: less serious than it looked, wait for the scan. The scan has not been published as a detailed bulletin. What has been published is availability. He was not in the Athletic eleven and not in Saturday's full group. Pedri can carry Rayo. The Champions League list begins nine days later. If Gavi is only ready for one of those two, Flick will have to choose between Liga control and European minutes. That is a selection problem, not a headline about a new long-term injury, until the club says otherwise. Pair it with Rodri's gym plan and the midfield looks shorter than the table. Two from two does not create extra midfielders. It only creates the temptation to start Pedri every third day. That temptation is how August turns into an October problem. Hold Gavi until the scan is public. Do not invent a six-week absence either.

headline.en: Barcelona paid 70 million plus add-ons for Gordon and 22 million plus add-ons for Adeyemi
headline.es: El Barca pago 70 millones mas variables por Gordon y 22 mas variables por Adeyemi

summary.en: Barcelona paid Newcastle 70 million euros plus 10 million in add-ons for Anthony Gordon and Dortmund 22 million plus seven million for Karim Adeyemi, according to Culemania. Rodri cost more than 70 million. Cancelo arrived free. Academy sales this week are smaller sums used to keep the 1:1 ratio in order.
summary.es: Culemania: 70 mas 10 por Gordon, 22 mas siete por Adeyemi. Rodri mas de 70. Cancelo libre. Las ventas de cantera sostienen el 1:1.

body.en: The 1:1 return is what made this summer possible. Without it, Gordon and Rodri do not land on the same list as Adeyemi and Cancelo. The fee table also explains why Deco is taking four million here and 3.5 million there for academy players. Those sales do not fund Rodri. They keep the ratio legal while the large contracts sit on the sheet. Fans will argue whether Gordon at 80 million all-in is the right profile. The accounts argument is narrower. Barcelona spent because the rule allowed it, and they are now selling the edges of the squad so the rule still holds in September. Livakovic's ficha sits in the same conversation. A fourth goalkeeper who cannot be named is another cost on a sheet that just absorbed four senior arrivals. Fair play is not a subplot. It is the reason some of these players are training with the group and still waiting to see if they can be listed. That is less exciting than a nine. It is the actual constraint.

headline.en: Joan Garcia has started both Liga matches and kept two clean sheets
headline.es: Joan Garcia ha sido titular en los dos partidos y no ha encajado

summary.en: Joan Garcia has started both Liga matches and kept two clean sheets. Marc-Andre ter Stegen is on loan at Ajax. Szczesny is the experienced deputy. Livakovic has a contract through 2030 and is waiting to see if he can be registered. Flick has said he wants experienced goalkeepers for the coming years.
summary.es: Garcia ha sido titular y no ha encajado. Ter Stegen esta en el Ajax. Szczesny es el suplente. Livakovic espera ficha.

body.en: The goalkeeping conversation is three stories stacked. Garcia has done the job in Liga. Ter Stegen's loan removed the previous number one from the daily noise. Livakovic is the long contract that may become a loan if the ficha does not appear. Flick's comment about experienced keepers was aimed at the years after Garcia's first season, not at Monday night. Rayo will shoot less than Athletic. The test for Garcia is handling and starting the press, not shot-stopping highlights. Two clean sheets are a start. They are not a closed argument if Livakovic is named later in the month. Until LaLiga publishes that name, write Garcia as the starter and Livakovic as an unresolved registration. Mixing those two facts is how a simple week becomes a false controversy. The squad has a number one. It also has a contract that still needs a list. Those can both be true.
